title: On Cauchy Problems for Parabolic Equations with Rough Coefficients
summary: The presented work investigates the Cauchy problems for parabolic equations in both non-divergence and divergence forms with rough diffusion coefficients, which commonly arise in composite media, financial pricing, and viscous fluids. Under critical regularity settings, we establish the unique solvability in optimal fractional Sobolev spaces. The first key technical step lies in constructing an effective approximation scheme with truncated and mollified diffusion coefficients $a^ε(t,x)$, for which we rigorously prove the uniform preservation of high-frequency smallness.
